summary: WAYLOAM v0.4.0.alpha replaces public route servers with the embedded WAYLOAM Router, adds verified offline routing-map preparation, route surface/climb intelligence and fast live route matching with exact rerouting.
highlights: Bicycle routes now run through the embedded WAYLOAM Router on the phone instead of public Valhalla/BRouter route endpoints.
Missing corridor .rd5 routing maps are resumably downloaded, verified and reused for future offline route calculations.
Planner routes expose paved/unpaved surface mix, climbs and cycling-specific route notices from proven BRouter/OSM metadata.
Ride mode uses indexed ON ROUTE / DRIFTING / OFF ROUTE matching and can reroute to an exact viable point ahead.
added: Pinned composite-build integration with loam-tools/wayloam-router for reproducible Android alphas.
Verified corridor routing-map preparation with local reuse, bounded downloads and progress reporting.
Persistent surface breakdown, route warnings and climb metrics in the active trip.
Router-backed live matching and exact forward rerouting in Ride mode.
changed: Build route now uses the embedded router as the primary and only bicycle route-calculation engine.
Route building reports place lookup, offline-map preparation and section routing states instead of one generic loading message.
GPS progress uses the router's pre-indexed geometry matcher rather than rescanning the entire polyline for each fix.
Nearby POI discovery remains asynchronous and can no longer determine whether the bicycle route itself succeeds.
fixed: Removed dependence on public routing-server long-distance queues that previously produced retry-later failures.
Repeat route builds reuse installed routing data and cached sections before performing unnecessary network metadata work.
Restored trips can rebuild their live navigation index after process or app restart.
Off-route recovery now recomputes the affected route to a valid point ahead instead of relying on approximate route progress.
